journal.text: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure (BSE:CIANAGRO, code 519477; not on NSE). Promoter/MD Nikhil Gadkari (son of MoRTH minister Nitin Gadkari); Manas Agro (run by Sarang Gadkari) is a subsidiary. Verified 5 Sep 2026: last 1,375.95 (-2.8% Fri), 6-month high 2,079.85 (-34%), 52w high 3,633 (-62%), below SMA20 (-3.5%) and SMA50 (-6.9%), 20d +1.2%, 60d -6%. Turnover ~8 cr/day (below 25 cr floor), 5% circuit band (1,307/1,445). Mcap ~3,763 cr, P/E 11.7. FY26 consolidated revenue 2,234 cr (+122%, mostly acquisitions incl. Manas Agro and a sugar/molasses trader), consolidated PAT 65 cr, standalone PAT 0.7 cr. Red flags: 44% of promoter stake pledged, profit reliant on other income, negative operating cash flow, institutional holding <0.2%, long-term ASM stage 4 (Sep 2025). Politics: Congress alleges conflict of interest and demands a Lokpal probe; Gadkari denies. Policy: E100 rules cleared 13 Jun 2026, E85 launched; E20 consumer backlash growing. Decision: NO position. Watch triggers: ethanol price/tender for ESY 2026-27 (Oct-Nov), any E27/E30 roadmap, reclaim of SMA50 on >3x volume, pledge reduction. Would only ever be a tiny, limit-order-only position because of the circuit band.

Macro diagnosis Sat 5 Sep 2026: (1) US-Iran strikes resumed this week after the July pause; Iran hit US bases, Jordan, Bahrain; Kuwait engaged missiles. Brent ~95; Hormuz disruption expected to persist into year-end (MOL). VLCC rates at record highs (TradeWinds 2 Sep). (2) FII outflows ~2.4 lakh cr YTD (record), DIIs absorbing ~90%; rupee 94.49 after RBI intervention + dollar deposits; forex reserves record USD 740.8 bn. (3) US Aug payrolls +162k vs +55k: Fed hike odds for 15-16 Sep above 50%; US CPI 11 Sep pivotal. (4) Domestic growth fine (FY26 GDP 7.6%, CPI 4.45%). Where money moved Fri: NSE-stake basket +4.1% (NIACL 17x vol), textile exporters +1.3% (Welspun Living +3.9%, +27% 20d, US 60% of revenue, 18% tariff vs 20% for Bangladesh/Vietnam), capital-market names (Angel One +4.8% on 5.5x, MCX +3.3%, BSE +3.1%), Reliance +1.8% (Jio Platforms IPO has SEBI nod; FE: Jio and NSE top a 4.66 lakh cr pipeline). Money leaving: Adani (-5% 20d; SEBI hearings target Hindenburg-linked short sellers, not Adani), toll roads/infra (-6% 20d), crude importers (paints, OMCs, aviation -5% 20d), sugar (-2.7% 5d after the 1 MT duty-free raw sugar import TRQ capped domestic prices; Renuka is the refiner beneficiary but at Rs 24 with thin volume; export ban to 30 Sep; ethanol price for ESY 2026-27 is a later catalyst). Unverified and NOT used: claim that Amit Shah's son owns an ethanol company (no filing or report found; only 2017 Temple Enterprise stories). Decisions: theses Swiggy 2,500 / GIC Re 2,000 / Oil India 2,400 (planned on kite); systematic sleeve 2 slots max, filtered scan leaders KRN, Jyoti CNC, Welspun Living, Shilpa Medicare, MCX; watch GE Shipping (laggard vs record tanker rates) and Reliance (Jio IPO date). Big IPO supply mid-Sep (NSE, Jio) may drain secondary liquidity: keep the 5% cash buffer.
